_comment: The roster. Hand-edited: the pipeline never writes here. Add a channel by adding an object. channel_id is REQUIRED before the daily sweep works: channels.list?id= batches 50 ids for 1 quota unit, while forHandle does not batch at all, so without ids the sweep costs 72 units instead of 2 and a handle rename silently forks the growth history. niche powers the leaderboard's peer filter. EXACTLY ONE row must have category='own'.

channels.name: Your Channel
channels.notes: Your own channel. Exactly one row must be category=own. It is the baseline every comparison runs against.
